name: dt_highroad_concept

slot.where: Downtown tall, the high road, camera y 120 x 1280

subject: make the old town house fronts rich and lovely like Gamla stan in Stockholm, and make every ledge belong to a building. Each house keeps its plaster colour and its windows where they are, and gets: a moulded cornice at the top of each storey, a thin string course between storeys, window surrounds with small pediments or keystones (the same on one storey, different house to house), a few painted wooden shutters and flower boxes with red geraniums, black iron wall anchors, a drainpipe between two houses. The arched stone gallery the dog stands on rests on carved stone corbels fixed to the wall; the iron balconies stand on stone slabs held by iron brackets; the stone balustrade galleries rest on corbels; the stepped grey brick piece becomes the stepped gable top of a house with a roof behind it. Nothing floats: every ledge is visibly held by the wall
extra: Bright warm afternoon colours, full local colour and crisp edges, the same flat-shaded pixel style as the dog. Keep the dog, the ledges' positions and the framing exactly as they are.
